name: gi-plugins
description: Production AI tooling for Grounded Intelligence clients.

plugins.name: lee-internal-comps
plugins.description: Comps (internal Dealius + external CoStar, lease & sale), demographic and business-key-facts reports, owner-of-record lookup, labor-shed workforce, traffic counts, owner mailing lists, and guided marketing-flyer intake for Lee & Associates Raleigh brokers. Headliners: internal-comps and internal-and-external-comps (Excel + Lee-branded PDF), demographic-summary/-detail and business-key-facts (Lee-branded PDFs), owner-lookup, labor-shed, owner-mailing-list, add-comps, lee-flyer-brief (guided flyer brief: pulls comps/demographics/owner data, broker curates, provenance-tagged brief, Claude Design handoff), vpd-lookup (traffic counts / AADT for the busiest roads near any NC address, with a flyer card), and nearby-businesses (Area Amenities map kit for any NC address: nearby businesses ranked by prominence with brand logos on a basemap, returned as a downloadable designer kit the marketing team composes into the flyer's amenities map), and comp-map (Lee-branded competitive-set map for an NC listing: deal mode maps the comps around a subject with numbered pins, rings, and a matching comp table; database mode maps the whole internal set or a broker's deal history; returns a shareable ~30-day interactive Google map link + print-ready PNG + a csm-* comp-table fragment for flyers/OMs/BOVs), and development-pipeline (what's being built around an address: the commercial development pipeline within a radius from 12 pre-staged NC municipal feeds, with stage counts, flyer-ready narrative bullet lines, a dpt-* flyer fragment, and a component PDF; wraps the lee-raleigh-mcp pull_development_pipeline tool). And tenant-search: which tenants are in the market for space right now — searches the shared Triangle Pairlist-sourced tenant-requirements pool by asset type, size, location, or recency and returns matches with the originating broker's contact to pair a listing. Plus process-mapping: a guided interview that maps any team member's repeatable process into a clean process-map document for GI (CRE = firm context, role-agnostic). And lee-branding: make anything you're building for a Lee broker look on-brand right in the chat — apply the Lee logo, the brand red, and the Avenir Next fonts to a flyer, one-pager, BOV/OM section, deck slide, chart, or email header on the spot with the exact fonts, colors, and logo rules baked in; the one-time Claude Design setup for the marketing team is the edge case. Ships the official Lee brand package (logo, colors, guidelines, fonts) bundled on disk.
